fair.title: Provably Fair
fair.heroText1: Every result is generated from our server seed, your client seed and a nonce.
fair.heroText2: We show the server seed hash before you play and reveal the seed when you rotate it — so nothing can be changed after the fact.
fair.step1Text: Before your roll we generate a secret server seed and show you its SHA-256 hash. The hash locks the seed — we can’t change it later.
fair.step2Text: Your browser creates a client seed you can edit at any time. A nonce counts your rolls: 1, 2, 3…
fair.step3Text: Rotate your seed pair to reveal the server seed. Put the three values into the verifier and get the exact same result.
fair.formulaNote: Each item in a case owns a range of tickets proportional to its drop chance. The ticket that falls into a range decides your drop.
fair.pvpServer: New per PvP, hash shown on join
fair.pvpClient: EOS block hash after all joined
fair.pvpOutput: Ticket per player · tie → seat by hash
fair.verifierHint: Paste a revealed server seed, your client seed and the nonce of the roll.
fair.rotateHint: Rotating reveals the current server seed and starts a new pair with nonce 0.
fair.noPrevious: Rotate once to reveal your first server seed.

faq.q1: Why can’t I see the server seed right away?
faq.a1: If you saw it before playing you could predict results. We show its SHA-256 hash first, and reveal the seed itself when you rotate your seed pair.
faq.q2: What happens when I rotate my seed pair?
faq.a2: The current server seed is revealed so you can verify every roll made with it. A new server seed is generated, its hash is shown, and the nonce starts again from 0.
faq.q3: Can KurwaDROP change a result after I play?
faq.a3: No. The server seed is fixed by its hash before you roll, your client seed is yours, and the nonce only goes up. Changing any value would change the hash you already saw.
faq.q4: Why does PvP use an EOS block?
faq.a4: In PvP nobody, including us, should control the client seed. A future EOS block hash is public, unpredictable and can be checked by anyone.
